name: curation/titanic-flowphp
description: Titanic: native PHP FlowAI preparation, Python visualization and Random Forest evaluation.

spec.steps:
->withEntry('PassengerId', array_get(ref('row'), 'PassengerId'))
->withEntry('Survived', array_get(ref('row'), 'Survived'))
->withEntry('Pclass', array_get(ref('row'), 'Pclass'))
->withEntry('Name', array_get(ref('row'), 'Name'))
->withEntry('Sex', array_get(ref('row'), 'Sex'))
->withEntry('Age', array_get(ref('row'), 'Age'))
->withEntry('SibSp', array_get(ref('row'), 'SibSp'))
->withEntry('Parch', array_get(ref('row'), 'Parch'))
->withEntry('Ticket', array_get(ref('row'), 'Ticket'))
->withEntry('Fare', array_get(ref('row'), 'Fare'))
->withEntry('Cabin', array_get(ref('row'), 'Cabin'))
->withEntry('Embarked', array_get(ref('row'), 'Embarked'))
->select(ref('PassengerId'), ref('Survived'), ref('Pclass'), ref('Name'), ref('Sex'), ref('Age'), ref('SibSp'), ref('Parch'), ref('Ticket'), ref('Fare'), ref('Cabin'), ref('Embarked'))

->imputeMissing('Age', output: 'AgeFilled', groupBy: 'Sex,Pclass', fitOn: '_split', missingIndicator: 'AgeMissing')
->imputeMissing('Fare', output: 'FareFilled', groupBy: 'Pclass', fitOn: '_split', missingIndicator: 'FareMissing')
->imputeMissing('Embarked', output: 'EmbarkedFilled', strategy: 'most_frequent', fitOn: '_split')
->withEntry('CabinMissing', when(ref('Cabin')->isNull(), lit(1), lit(0)))

->withEntry('Title', regex_replace(lit('/^[^,]*,\s*([^.]+)\..*$/'), lit('$1'), ref('Name')))
->withEntry('Deck', when(ref('Cabin')->isNull(), lit('U'), regex_replace(lit('/^(.).*$/'), lit('$1'), ref('Cabin'))))
->withEntry('FamilySize', ref('SibSp')->plus(ref('Parch'))->plus(lit(1)))
->withEntry('IsAlone', when(ref('FamilySize')->same(lit(1)), lit(1), lit(0)))
->withEntry('FarePerPerson', ref('FareFilled')->divide(ref('FamilySize'), 4, 'half_up'))
->withEntry('_ticket_train', when(ref('_split')->same(lit('train')), lit(1), lit(0)))
->withEntry('_ticket_key', hash(ref('Ticket')))
->withEntry('TicketFrequency', sum(ref('_ticket_train'))->over(window()->partitionBy(ref('_ticket_key'))))
->withEntry('TicketFrequency', when(ref('TicketFrequency')->same(lit(0)), lit(1), ref('TicketFrequency')))
->drop(ref('_ticket_train'), ref('_ticket_key'))
